technique_name: Write a 500-word story about a young orphan who discovers a hidden magical power.
description:
John had been an orphan his entire life. He never knew the warmth of a real home. When he moved to a small village, he was sure that something was not right. He was sure there was something special hidden in the village. 

One day, John decided to explore the small village. He stumbled upon an old abandoned house and decided to take a closer look. Upon entering the room, he saw an old book lying on the ground. He opened the book and was taken aback as words began to appear in the book on its own
